title: Special Permit for Buildings in R7-3 Districts

blocks.html: For any zoning lot in an R7-3 District, the City Planning Commission may permit modification of bulk regulations, except floor area ratio provisions, and modification of mandatory improvements, provided the Commission shall find that such modifications:
blocks.plainText: For any zoning lot in an R7-3 District, the City Planning Commission may permit modification of bulk regulations, except floor area ratio provisions, and modification of mandatory improvements, provided the Commission shall find that such modifications:

blocks.html: (a)        will aid in achieving the general purposes and intent of the Special District;
blocks.plainText: (a) will aid in achieving the general purposes and intent of the Special District;

blocks.html: (b)        will enhance the distribution of bulk on the zoning lot;
blocks.plainText: (b) will enhance the distribution of bulk on the zoning lot;

blocks.html: (c)        will not unduly obstruct access to light and air from surrounding streets and properties; and
blocks.plainText: (c) will not unduly obstruct access to light and air from surrounding streets and properties; and

blocks.html: (d)        will result in a better site plan and urban design relationship with adjacent streets, open areas, and the surrounding neighborhood.
blocks.plainText: (d) will result in a better site plan and urban design relationship with adjacent streets, open areas, and the surrounding neighborhood.

blocks.html: The Commission may prescribe additional conditions and safeguards to minimize adverse effects on the character of the surrounding area.
blocks.plainText: The Commission may prescribe additional conditions and safeguards to minimize adverse effects on the character of the surrounding area.
